nfc15774a52.headline: Croatia rings in the New Year as a fully integrated EU member
nfc15774a52.summary: Croatia rang in the New Year as a fully integrated EU member, a fresh start for the Balkan nation of about 4 million people.
nfc15774a52.why: EU membership gives member states access to the single market and EU funding, and shapes trade, regulation and investment conditions.

n84708c01da.headline: Dubai: Alcohol sales increase after 30% tax removal, claims distributor
n84708c01da.summary: A distributor claims alcohol sales increased after a 30% tax was removed. Personal liquor licences are now free of cost for eligible residents.
n84708c01da.why: Consumer taxes and licensing rules shape retail and hospitality demand in Dubai, a major tourism and consumer market.

n22d77653d2.headline: New housing supply up 51 pc in 2022 across 7 cities; NCR sees 20 pc fall in launches: Report
n22d77653d2.summary: New housing supply rose 51% in 2022 across seven cities, with launches up in Mumbai, Kolkata, Bengaluru, Hyderabad and Pune but down 20% in Delhi-NCR, a report said.
n22d77653d2.why: Housing supply trends indicate the health of India's real estate sector, which influences construction, banking credit and related consumer demand.

n9019816cd6.summary: Bank Hapoalim CEO Dov Kotler said more than 10,000 customers would benefit from a freeze on mortgage rates amid Israel's housing crisis.
n9019816cd6.why: Bank Hapoalim is one of Israel's largest banks, and its mortgage pricing affects household borrowing and the local housing market.

n35d8e24f67.headline: Education gets a major boost in Budget 2023
n35d8e24f67.summary: Oman's Ministry of Finance said the state general budget calculates the average oil price at about $55 a barrel. The assumption is part of the budget's revenue planning for the year.
n35d8e24f67.why: Oman's budget depends heavily on oil revenue, so its oil price assumption shapes fiscal planning and spending.

nfce7c099f0.headline: Upcoming Large Economic Projects to Link Saudi Arabia, Oman
nfce7c099f0.summary: Oman's sovereign wealth fund executive said economic ties with Saudi Arabia have made great strides toward integration. Large economic projects linking the two countries are upcoming.
nfce7c099f0.why: Cross-border infrastructure and investment projects between Gulf states can create contracting and investment opportunities in the region.

n55e57a8184.headline: Ukraine faces grim start to 2023 after fresh Russian attacks
n55e57a8184.summary: Air raid sirens sounded in the Ukrainian capital shortly after midnight, followed by a barrage of missiles. The attacks mark a difficult start to the year for the country.
n55e57a8184.why: Ongoing war in Ukraine affects energy supply, grain exports and investor risk appetite across Europe and emerging markets.

n710006230e.headline: Saudi Arabia Aims to Boost National Automotive Industry
n710006230e.summary: Saudi Arabia's Ministry of Industry and Mineral Resources signed a memorandum of understanding with Hyundai Motor Company to promote the Kingdom's automotive industry. The signing took place in the presence of two ministers.
n710006230e.why: Hyundai Motor is a South Korean carmaker, and government partnerships like this one aim to build local vehicle manufacturing as part of Saudi economic diversification.

n7e030462d5.headline: Shops face challenging year ahead, says industry body
n7e030462d5.summary: The British Retail Consortium predicts the first half of 2023 will be particularly difficult for shops. The industry body's outlook points to a challenging year ahead for retailers.
n7e030462d5.why: The British Retail Consortium is the main trade body for UK retailers, and its outlook signals pressure on consumer spending and store sales.

nfd02036e97.headline: HNWIs, visa reforms drive Dubai real estate market in 2022
nfd02036e97.summary: Dubai's property market is reported to have performed strongly in 2022, supported by high-net-worth individuals and visa reforms. The article is a market overview.
nfd02036e97.why: Dubai is a major global real estate hub, and its property prices and transaction volumes influence investor flows into the United Arab Emirates.

n20fc8c12f9.headline: GST collections grow 15 pc to Rs 1.49 lakh cr in December
n20fc8c12f9.summary: Gross GST revenue collected in December 2022 totalled Rs 1,49,507 crore, including Rs 78,434 crore of IGST. Rs 40,263 crore of IGST was collected on imports.
n20fc8c12f9.why: GST is India's main indirect tax, and monthly collections are a closely watched gauge of consumption and tax-revenue health in Asia's third-largest economy.

n9908000e46.headline: New housing supply up 51% in 2022 across 7 cities; NCR sees 20% fall in launches: Report - Times of India
n9908000e46.summary: New residential supply rose 51% last year to 357,635 units across seven major cities as builders launched more projects. The National Capital Region saw launches fall 20%.
n9908000e46.why: Housing supply and launch volumes are key indicators for India's real estate sector, which is closely tied to credit conditions, household demand and developers' earnings.

n9bb3bd8cd4.summary: Tesla CEO Elon Musk has seen his wealth tumble in recent weeks after shares of the electric carmaker fell, making him the first person to lose $200 billion.
